notes:
Account summary
- Mid-market RAG/search vendor (multi-tenant) evaluating Redwood for inference layer + cost optimization. They currently run a mixed fleet and are comparing managed endpoints vs self-host.
- Strong cost sensitivity; leadership is pushing for quantization (INT8 first; FP8 is of interest but they’re wary of long-context quality).

Workload / requirements (from discovery + deep dive)
- Primary workloads:
  - Embeddings (high QPS, latency sensitive, wants stable throughput)
  - Reranking (quality-sensitive; worried INT8 changes relevance ordering)
  - Answer generation / summarization (mix of short and long context; spikes in concurrency)
- Latency targets (stated on calls):
  - End-to-end API p95 for generation: <2.5s on typical RAG prompts; want TTFT consistency more than peak tokens/s.
  - Embeddings/rerank: want p95 <250ms during steady state; p99 tail is currently a problem during traffic bursts.
- Traffic profile:
  - Heavy weekday burstiness; needs predictable throttling/backpressure rather than random tail spikes.
  - Prompt-length distribution is bimodal: short queries + occasional long docs (8k-16k context) for enterprise tenants.

Quantization questions / concerns (verbatim-ish)
- "How do you prevent INT8 from silently changing ranking quality?"
- "If a specific shape/model combo is bad, can you automatically fall back without us noticing downtime?"
- Wants to understand whether the gains are kernel-level only or realized end-to-end once batching/scheduling is accounted for.

What we told them (positioning + guardrails)
- We emphasized we will not recommend/enable INT8 by default without:
  - Clear shape guardrails + correctness fallbacks in runtime dispatch
  - Evals sign-off on representative prompt sets (Applied ML criteria)
  - Canary gating by model/region/cohort with automatic rollback on TTFT/TPOT regressions
- Noted that end-to-end wins depend on scheduler settings (prefill/decode mix, batching window, backpressure); we will provide recommended defaults + measurement plan.

Deployment / security
- Prefers VPC deployment for production due to enterprise customers; open to Hosted for dev/test.
- Security asks: SSO/SAML, audit logs, configurable retention, KMS integration, and a story for data residency (at least US + EU).

Commercial
- Exploring Dedicated (H100) for steady-state + cost-focused tier (A100 or L4) for lower-SLA tenants; wants routing/fallback policy.
- Needs: clear unit economics comparison (cost per 1M tokens, cost per 1k queries embeddings/rerank) and guidance on where INT8 helps most.

Open items / next steps

  - Approved benchmark excerpt: INT8 vs baseline on H100 for representative shapes/workloads + required footnotes
  - Summary of known INT8 quality risks + mitigations (calibration requirements; when to require eval sign-off)
  - Draft pilot plan: their prompt set + Redwood benchmark runner + canary thresholds/rollback triggers
